title: Fairness in Large Language Models: A Taxonomic Survey
findings: As a survey paper, it does not present new findings but summarizes the state of the field. It reports that Large Language Models can lead to discrimination against various populations based on dimensions including religion, citing specific work on anti-Muslim bias. The paper categorizes and reviews various datasets (e.g., BOLD, StereoSet, HolisticBias) and techniques developed to quantify and mitigate religious bias in LLMs.
references: Abubakar Abid, Maheen Farooqi, and James Zou. 2021. Persistent anti-muslim bias in large language models. In Proceedings of the 2021 AAAI/ACM Conference on AI, Ethics, and Society. 298-306.
